[Step 0 — scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: business_ext_period_subscription_charge / collect_overdue_subscription_325cf5bc and business_ext_downgrade_termination_charge / schedule_plan_downgrade_6c5bcb1c. Claimed here (all unoccupied): business_ext_withdrawable_balance (owner tool withdraw_business_balance_ad66ed9d), business_ext_mid_period_seat_charge (charge_extra_seats_0d292d98), business_ext_upgrade_proration_settlement (settle_upgrade_proration_4280c277), business_ext_card_deposit_fee (charge_card_deposit_fee_e69fd8f7). This is the last task; the six policies are now all covered, pairwise disjoint. Task 0's subscription charge rule is reused only as history: the seeded subscription charges of this account are what that rule gives at each period start (Growth, 49.00 list): 2026-04-05 47.00, 05-05 35.00, 06-05 47.00, 07-05 44.55, 08-05 32.55, 09-05 32.55 (recomputed by script on the seeded rows); the 2026-03-05 charge of 41.00 rests on February activity outside the seeded window.

[Why this is a good test] Kwame asks only to withdraw as much as Paloma allows today. The withdrawable amount's own rule states three waits: 'The withdrawable amount is not worked out until the balance carries an extra seat fee for every user added in the past month while more users were active than the plan includes.' / 'The withdrawable amount is worked out only after an upgrade that took effect inside the current billing period carries its proration charge on the balance.' / 'Before the withdrawable amount is worked out, the most recent debit-card deposit must carry its deposit fee on the balance.' The records show 15 active users against 10 included with no extra seat fee, a Pro plan effective 2026-09-07 inside the period with no proration charge, and debit-card deposit DEP-56638842 with no fee. Each is resolved by exactly one write of this difficulty (the seat charge, the proration settlement and the card deposit fee rules each book that entry), each computed with four factors from users, approvals, batch payouts, SWIFT fees, deposits and dates; only then can the five-factor withdrawable amount be worked out on the lowered balance. Breadth: fan-out of three value-carrying prerequisites plus a cross-difficulty reserve relief. Multi-source factors of this task: ach_hold_method, settled_share_method, upgrade_incentive, bank_funding_reduction, seat_period_method.

[Problem-tree card]
root business_ext_withdrawable_balance (owner). Edges (all kind value_input, gate balance_now, form state):
 -> business_ext_mid_period_seat_charge, sentence 1 above (negated direction 'not ... until'), condition 'The ledger carries an extra seat fee entry for the current billing period covering the users added in the past month beyond the included seats, and the balance reflects it.' Unmet: no extra_seat_fee entry for 2026-09-05; users added 2026-09-08..09-22. Only the seat charge rule books extra seat fees mid-period.
 -> business_ext_upgrade_proration_settlement, sentence 2 (affirmative 'only after'), condition: a proration charge entry for the period of an account whose plan took effect inside it. Unmet: plan_effective_date 2026-09-07, period start 2026-09-05, no proration_charge entry. Only the proration settlement rule books it.
 -> business_ext_card_deposit_fee, sentence 3 (affirmative 'before ... must'), condition: the most recent debit-card deposit has a deposit fee entry. Unmet: DEP-56638842 (2026-09-23, 12,000.00) has none. Only the card deposit fee rule books card deposit fees.
Four-point test on each: ordering connective; record-visible state named in ledger words; no tool, id or code token; exact scope (the users added in the past month beyond included seats / an upgrade inside the current period / the most recent debit-card deposit, the one the card fee rule prices). Directions are chosen per result: a withdrawal is 'not worked out until' what it waits for stands, and is 'worked out only after' a charge stands.
Topological order: seat (step 8), proration (10), card fee (12), withdrawal (14). The three prerequisites commute (run card -> seat -> proration: same amounts, balance 23,422.79, withdrawal 22,853.39). Deletion sensitivity (actual runs): without the seat charge the withdrawal is 22,860.06, without the proration 22,922.94, without the card fee 23,007.39; on the opening world 23,083.61.
Customer's own write: the withdrawal (base: withdrawing the balance is the owner's own decision), handed over with unlock_user_discoverable_tool. user_scenario never names a seat fee, proration or deposit fee; the upgrade, staff logins and top-ups come out only if the agent asks. No tool checks any prerequisite.

[Base-invariant card]
seat charge (subject business_user_added): business_evt_seats account_open_for_users (status active) and seat_cap (15 active <= Pro max 40). proration (subject business_proration_credited): business_evt_plan_change, no gate on that subject -> policy_scope; Growth allows upgrade proration and its 2026-09-05 subscription charge (32.55) was collected. card fee (subject business_balance_deposited): business_evt_balance deposit_status (active). withdrawal (subject business_balance_withdrawn): business_agg_entity_separation own_balance_only (taken from this account's balance) and business_evt_balance withdrawal_status (active, suspension none). No time gate applies to any of the four writes.
Overwrites: seats 'A user added during a period ... charged extra_seat_fee_usd for that period at once ... not prorated ...' -> the seat charge combination sentence; balance 'A debit-card deposit carries card_deposit_fee_pct ...' -> the card rate sentence (wire fee restated unchanged); plan_change 'On an upgrade from a plan whose upgrade_proration_enabled is true ...' -> the net proration sentence (credit and charge settled as one proration charge); balance 'it may not exceed the available balance less charges still owed.' -> the withdrawable amount sentence.

[Business-object card] One owner, one account a9d2e7a0-cbf1-4dcd-bdb7-9cd1f24693ad (Pro since 2026-09-07, Growth before; KYB 2023-04-05; billing day 5; period 2026-09-05..2026-10-04). Seat charge: users added after 2026-08-25 (10) capped at active users beyond included (5). Proration: the 2026-09-07 upgrade and the 32.55 Growth charge of the period. Card fee: DEP-56638842 only (DEP-56437709 and DEP-56540381 already carry fees of 39.00 and 97.50, as the card rule gave on their dates). [Factor cards]
seat charge 6.67 (baseline 35.00): seat_period_method (method; 41 months AND 10 of 30 days left -> days-left share rounded up; baseline full -> 20.00); seat_volume_reduction (5 beyond -> 1.00; near-miss: ignoring the 2026-04-14 removal gives 6 beyond and 2.00; baseline -> 8.00); approver_seats (3 approvals -> 1 freed; -> 8.34); batch_operations_reduction (4 batch payouts -> 1.00; -> 8.00).
proration 69.55 (baseline 90.02): settled_share_method (method; monthly, 2 days used -> share 1; baseline 28/30 -> 63.98); upgrade_incentive (multi-source: 88,690.00 principal (>= 60,000.00, under the 150,000.00 first tier) AND 41 months -> 10 percent; -> 82.45); swift_rebate_rate (59.97 -> 10 percent = 6.00; near-miss 2026-06-25 SWIFT fee on the boundary day -> 79.96 and 20 percent; -> 75.55); upgrade_deposit_credit (94,500.00 -> 8.00; -> 77.55).
card fee 154.00 (baseline 300.00): deposit_size_rate (12,000.00 -> 1.80; -> 231.00); card_volume_reduction (18,000.00 -> 0.15; near-miss 2026-06-25 card deposit on the boundary day -> 21,000.00 and 0.30; -> 170.50); bank_funding_reduction (multi-source: 4 ACH AND 2 card -> 0.25; -> 181.50); card_fee_charging_method (method; 41 months -> above 1,000.00; whole deposit -> 168.00).
withdrawable 22,853.39 (baseline 16,035.89): reserve_basis_window (method; 14 payouts in three months -> past month's principal 33,660.00; three months 88,690.00 -> 22,027.94); ach_hold_method (method, multi-source; 41 months AND 9 ACH deposits -> nothing held; baseline holds the 6,500.00 deposit of 2026-09-24 -> 16,353.39); reserve_rate_by_returns (one return 2026-03-24 -> 3 percent; standing 1 percent -> 23,189.99); personal_reserve_relief (cross-difficulty account; level and status read from the one Personal Sender Account row, so not counted as multi-source: Paloma Enhanced AND active -> 50 percent; -> 22,348.49); next_charge_reserve (10 days to 2026-10-05 -> 64.50; -> 22,917.89).

[Seed design] customers; sender_accounts (Paloma Enhanced, active — cross-difficulty evidence with no open item in the account difficulty); business_accounts; business_ledger (12 deposits, 7 allowance grants and 6 lapses, 7 subscription fees, 30 payout debits, 26 allowance uses, 4 SWIFT fees, return credit-back and return fee, 2 card deposit fees, 3 withdrawals); business_payouts (30 submissions, 3 approvals, 30 releases, 29 payments, 1 return); business_events (15 additions, 1 removal, 6 KYB documents: five logged 2023-03-28..03-31 for the Growth application, the business bank statement logged 2026-09-04 for the move to Pro). Lowest running balance 1,643.01 (2026-09-05); balance 23,653.01 and 37 free payouts equal the ledger sums. No cache trap.

[Persona] Kwame is formal and wants numbers stated; he opens with the surface goal, gives phone/DOB/ZIP when asked, names the Chase account on file, reveals the upgrade/staff logins and top-ups only when asked, agrees to have charges booked once explained, runs the withdrawal tool himself with the values handed over, and closes on confirmation.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify -> read account, ledger, payouts, users, Personal Sender Account -> book seat charge 6.67 (seq 1) -> proration 69.55 -> card fee 154.00 on DEP-56638842 -> owner withdraws 22,853.39 (seq 2).
[Verification run] Script replays gold with the real tools and evaluates each compute in check_compute's sandbox at its handling time; results and every factor baseline as listed. Gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

user_scenario:
You are Kwame Osei Asante, 48, managing member of Asante Freight Forwarding LLC in southwest Houston, which clears and moves cargo for West African importers. You are calling Paloma on a Friday afternoon between meetings; you are courteous, a bit formal, and you like to hear numbers stated clearly before anything is done.

What you want: you need to move money out of the company's Paloma Business balance today into the company's Chase operating account, which is already the verified bank account on the Paloma Business account, because customs duties and payroll are due next week. You want to take out as much as Paloma will let you withdraw today, not a round figure of your own; you do not know what that amount is and never propose one. You open with something like: "Good afternoon. I need to withdraw as much as I can from our Paloma Business balance today, to our usual bank account — can you tell me how much that is and help me do it?"

You give your identity details only when asked: your mobile number is 3465550193, your date of birth is 1977-11-02 and your home ZIP code is 77072. If asked for your email it is kwame@asantefreight.com; if asked for the business name it is Asante Freight Forwarding LLC. If asked which bank account, you say the Chase account already on file, the only one you have ever withdrawn to. Only if the agent asks about recent changes on the account do you mention that you moved the business up to the Pro plan at the start of the month and have been adding staff logins for the new Lagos desk; only if asked about recent deposits do you say you topped the balance up by debit card on Wednesday and by ACH on Thursday.

You have not looked at the fee lines on the account this month. If the agent explains that some charges have to be put on the account before the withdrawable amount can be worked out, you ask them to go ahead and book them, and you accept the amounts they tell you. When the agent tells you how much can be withdrawn, you accept it. Withdrawing is your own action: when the agent hands you the withdrawal tool and tells you the values to enter, you run it once yourself with exactly the account, sequence number and amount the agent gives you, and you read back the amount and balance it shows. Once the agent confirms the withdrawal is on its way, you thank them and end the call without asking for anything else.
